turns.question: What was our win rate on the search leads that came in during September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no win-rate metric; the closest is the lead-to-booking rate (share of leads that booked within 30 days of being created, counted on the lead's creation day), which for search-channel leads created 1 to 30 September 2026 is 33.7%. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
